meta.label: Real county values exported from the Python engine feature table.
notes: Regenerate this file after feature data, pillar semantics, gates, or presets change.
Missing values retain the engine null policy: they are ignored in pillar means and never fail gates.

description.pillar: A pillar score averages the metrics that have data. Missing metrics are left out of the average.
description.composite: When a whole pillar has no data, the composite reweights over the pillars that do.
description.gate: A gate never excludes a county for missing data. It marks the gate as unknown.

gates.label: Plant capacity within 100 km at least
Water stress at most, if evaporative

presets.label: Balanced
presets.description: Even weights, moderate gates. The default demo profile.

presets.label: Speed to power
presets.description: A developer with a signed tenant and a 2028 deadline. Interconnection wait and permitting risk dominate. Carbon is a constraint on the tenant's side, not the developer's.

presets.label: Sustainability first
presets.description: A hyperscaler with a 24/7 carbon-free energy commitment and a water stewardship target. Willing to wait for power. Scores the 2050 horizon because the facility will run for 30 years.
